notes:
- Installers downloaded from a9voice.com now carry a random code in the file name. The app sends it once with the first-launch count, so we know which link a download came from. It isn't tied to you, it is deleted after it is sent (or unsent when **Send anonymous usage counts** is off), and the file is byte for byte the same installer.
- **Settings › Privacy** now lists five one-time counts: setup finished, first dictation, first note, Notes trial started and Notes bought. They follow the same switch; a license you already had, or a trial that started before this version, sends nothing.
- The download page says the saved file name ends in a short download code.
